$comment: Per-route-group budgets (CLAUDE.md performance budgets). Values are gzipped bytes of first-load JavaScript, measured on the production build with the labelled test double. A group's budget applies to every route in it. 'targetGzipBytes' (where set) is the goal and only reported; 'budgetGzipBytes' is the hard cap and fails CI. Signed-in routes carry a session cookie; the cookie value is a test token (test double), not a credential. Groups with no routes yet reserve their budget for the features that will add them.
